start_here: Say to your AI: "Check bakery/rewrite.md against bakery/TEMPLATE.json and tell me which fixed words I changed." It runs tool:check-words-against-a-word-template and writes bakery/report2.json.

lists.label: Settings
lists.holds: One row per tool and scope (a person, a film, a piece or the whole account): the settings that tool reads when it runs, as JSON. For this folder the account row holds your own dimensions registry.
alike: a config sheet or settings spreadsheet
a notes page of defaults per project

instructions: 1. Have a template (tool:make-a-word-template) and the script to judge: a markdown file with a fenced dim:speech.word block (what tool:fill-a-word-template writes), or plain text, or a piece JSON.

2. Say to your AI: "Check bakery/rewrite.md against bakery/TEMPLATE.json". It reads the row with tools:list and runs python3 -I tools/fill-a-template-without-changing-its-words/do-work/drift.py bakery/TEMPLATE.json bakery/rewrite.md --check --json bakery/report2.json
3. Read the verdict first (CHECK: PASS or FAIL), then each fixed word deleted, replaced or added with its line, and each slot that is empty, unsourced or still holds the original's value.
4. Exit 1 means a dimension missed its threshold: that is a finding, not a failure to run. Fix the rewrite, or pass a deliberate change back in an exceptions file with a reason (--exceptions FILE).
5. After a pass, move events tied to the words with tool:re-time-events-tied-to-words.
6. Optional: if you keep your own dimensions registry as a row of list:settings, read that row with records:read, write it to a file and add --settings-record FILE to the command.

worked_examples.title: A rewrite that changed "before" to "after" and used an unsourced 52
worked_examples.ask: Check my rewrite against the template.
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/fill-a-template-without-changing-its-words/do-work/drift.py and run for real with the bakery template and bakery/rewrite.md, which holds "Sam baked 52 loaves after dawn and sold them all." in a dim:speech.word block: python3 -I tools/fill-a-template-without-changing-its-words/do-work/drift.py bakery/TEMPLATE.json bakery/rewrite.md --check --json bakery/report2.json
worked_examples.hands_back: Exit 1 and the report: KEEP preserved: 88.9% (8 of 9 KEEP values); CHECK: FAIL - speech.word: 88.9% of KEEP preserved, needs 100%; 1 slot fill(s) without a valid source. EVERY KEEP CHANGE (1): speech.word speech.word:L1 replaced: 'before' -> 'after'. Annotated line: Sam baked [-40-]{+52+} loaves [-before-]{+after+} dawn and sold them all. Slot auto-number-w2 is unsourced. Run on the filled script instead and it exits 0 with CHECK: PASS at 100.0% (9/9).

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for tool settings and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and list:settings as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
